plan.title: Streamlit Deal Database Dashboard
plan.summary: A Streamlit web app that exposes the PTBot SQLite database through three pages: Dashboard (KPIs + charts), Deal Browser (filterable/searchable deal table with multiples detail), and Request Industries (form to define sweep targets, trigger ptbot-sweep locally or via cloud agents, and stream live output).
deliverables: src/ptbot/app.py — Streamlit app with three-page layout
pyproject.toml updated with [app] optional dependency group: streamlit, pandas, plotly
Taskfile.yml updated with 'task app' entry point
constraints: No new runtime dependencies in core ptbot package — app deps are optional [app] group
app.py excluded from mypy and ruff coverage gates (Streamlit global-scope pattern is not type-safe)
DB is read-only in Dashboard and Deal Browser — only Request Industries triggers writes via ptbot-sweep subprocess
